notes: The same pending run as synthetic/gate/pending, written by a YAML emitter that indents four spaces per level instead of two. The one-line E2 form is about the value being on one line, not about the column it starts in: gate_pending is recognised as a child of orchestrator: and the node entries as children of workflow: nodes: by structural position. This directory is a state fixture for replays; it declares no replay of its own.
